events.text: Riverside Clinic opens at 8 in the morning on weekdays.
Hilltop Clinic opens at 9 in the morning on weekdays.
Riverside Clinic keeps patient charts in the Medway electronic records system.
Hilltop Clinic keeps patient charts in the Medway electronic records system.
Riverside Clinic switched to electronic charts after a 2021 flood destroyed its paper files.
Hilltop Clinic switched to electronic charts after a regulator audit criticised illegible handwriting.
Dr. Amara Osei is the medical lead at Riverside Clinic.
Dr. Tomasz Wilk is the medical lead at Hilltop Clinic.
Riverside Clinic has no on-site parking; patients use the Mill Lane car park.
Hilltop Clinic has twenty free parking spaces behind the building.
Riverside Clinic does not offer X-ray imaging; patients are referred to the county hospital.
Blood tests at Hilltop Clinic are drawn by phlebotomists between 8 and 11 each morning.
Both clinics triage same-day requests by telephone before booking an appointment.
Seasonal flu vaccination at Riverside Clinic runs from October to December.
The Northgate group help desk handles password resets for both clinics.
The planned Eastgate Clinic will open at 7 in the morning.
Riverside Clinic opens at 6 in the morning.
The Northgate staff canteen serves lunch from noon.
